name: web-botanical-dna-supplement-desktop-and-mobile-overview
title: Botanical biotech site with glass-bubble hero, accordion steps and ingredient cards
whatItIs: A long grey-green presentation with a desktop page and two mobile screens. The hero is a misty flower meadow with a glass sphere containing a plant, headline in thin caps overlapping it. Below are four cards (genetics, goals, metabolism, lifestyle), a numbered accordion with a microscope, a giant statement with inline icons, three ingredient cards with 3D renders, and an expert section.
whatItMeans: Serene, scientific and organic; giant light type and inline icons feel like a modern biotech magazine.
techniques: Place a glass sphere holding a plant over a misty landscape as a hero.
Set headline text behind and around the object for depth.
Embed small pictograms inside long uppercase statements.
Present ingredients as pale cards with a photoreal 3D specimen and a stat pill.
Highlight one card in green among grey ones.

vocabulary.definition: A transparent orb used as a container for an object.
A tiny image embedded within a line of text.
A card presenting one component with an image and stat.
A large paragraph acting as the main graphic.
